method: Historical mechanical steelhead replay using Grand River at Grand Rapids — Fulton Street USGS 04119000 daily mean discharge, Grand River at North Park Street — measured water temperature USGS 04118564 daily mean measured water temperature, and each four-hour block's Open-Meteo radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to This read combines Fulton Street flow, North Park measured water temperature, and Grand Rapids weather for the downtown Grand Rapids mainstem. It does not directly measure Grand Haven, the full Lower river, or reaches upstream of North Park. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
